# Share

## Share

Share SDK allows the user to share the app page to the chatroom. The latest Share SDK allow developers to set respective URL for the mobile client and the desktop client separately, which can be very flexible to suit different app capabilities on different clients.

From SeaTalk 3.11.0, we provided the new Share SDK which this doc introduces to, meanwhile the old Share SDK is still supported.

### function ShareApp

```javascript
sdkClient.share.shareApp(content: UniShareAppContent): Promise<void> Copy
```

### Reminder

1. Should only share the content inside the current app, SeaTalk will verify it if not then there will be an error.
2. Developers can specify using the RN or Web capability to open the shared content, also they should try to make sure the RN or Web page works well.
3. In the shared link, if there is any special character please use 'encodeRUI' to code, otherwise there will be an error.

### Interface UniShareAppContent

|Parameter|Required|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|title|Yes|string|The title shown in the message.|
|subtitle|No|string \| undefined|The subtitle shown in the message.|
|image|No|LocalImage \| RemoteImage|Remote URL of the leading image to be shown in the message.|
|mobileLink|No|IShareLinkMobile|Specifies the destination when the shared app page message is clicked on the mobile.|
|desktopLink|No|IShareLinkDesktop|Specifies the destination when the shared app page message is clicked on the desktop. Note: at least one of the mobileLink or desktopLink should be filled.|

### Interface

```javascript
export type FileType = 'cache' | 'document'export interface FileInfo {
    type: FileType
    /** Relative path under the directory specified by {@link type} */
    path: string
}
export interface LocalImage {
    type: 'local'
    image: FileInfo
}
export interface RemoteImage {
    type: 'remote'
    imageUrl: string
}
export interface IShareLinkMobile {
    type: 'rn' | 'web'
    path: string
    params: Record<string, string>
}
export interface IShareLinkDesktop {
    type: 'web'
    path: string
    params: Record<string, string>
} Copy
```

Developers can choose proper app capabilities for the mobile client and the desktop client:

1. Mobile: Currently support RN or Web, so that the user can open the shared app page via proper capability on the mobile client.
2. Desktop: Currently support Web, so that the user can open the shared app page via the web capability on the desktop client.

### Response

RN SDK response in Promise form. When 'Resolve' will response with void data, when 'Reject' will response customized Error type.

|Parameter|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|
|code|Number|Error Code|
|message|String|Error Message|

Error Code

* 1: user cancel sharing
* 2: untrust domain(share the external content)
* 3: fail to compose the sharing link
* 1000: error inside the app
* 1001: not allowed parameters
* 1002: none existing function

Error Message

* 1: shareApp:fail User cancel share
* 2: shareApp:fail Untrusted web domain
* 3: shareApp:fail Generate share link error
* 1000: shareApp:fail Native app internal error
* 1001: shareApp:fail Invalid parameters
* 1002: shareApp:fail Function not found

### Example

```javascript
import { sdkClient } from '../client';

try {
    await sdkClient.share.shareApp({
        title: "Cooper's Post",
        subtitle: 'I post a object to announce the news',
        image: {
            type: 'remote',
            imageUrl: 'https: //seatalk.io/xxx.png',
        },
        mobileLink: {
            type: 'web',
            path: encodeURI('https: //seatalk.io/'),
            params: {
                name: encodeURI('Post Shared'),
            },
        },
    });
    console.log('Share Success');
} catch (e) {
    console.log('Share Failed', e);
} Copy
```
